title: Code Eazz
description: Showcase your problem-solving skills in our Code Eazz coding contest! Put your logic and efficiency to the test as you race against the clock to solve challenging algorithmic problems. Whether you’re a beginner or an expert, this is your chance to shine, compete, and win exciting prizes. Join us for a fast-paced session of coding, creativity, and friendly competition—it's time to code your way to victory!
guidelines: It is mandatory for all the participants to bring their own laptops and chargers.
Ensure your laptop has a minimum of 2 hours of battery life and bring fully charged laptops.
Participants must be present at the venue at least 15 minutes before the scheduled start time.
Use of LLMs(Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude etc.) is strictly prohibited.
No plagiarism — all solutions must be original.
Decisions of the judges will be final and binding.
eligibility: Participants must be students of VIT Pune.
Coding competition is open to Second-Year students belonging to Data Science Department only.

title: Model Building and Evaluation
description: Our Model Building and Evaluation session offered students fundamental insights into machine learning, model development, and assessment.

title: API creation Using Springboot
description: Participants dived into backend development during our hands-on workshop on creating RESTful APIs using Spring Boot. Attendees learned to design, build, and deploy APIs with one of Java’s most popular frameworks, sharpening their programming skills and mastering core backend development principles.

title: GD & PI Preparation Session
description: Tailored for upcoming internships and final placements, this session equipped participants with key skills, confidence, and strategies to ace Group Discussions and Personal Interviews. Attendees mastered techniques for articulation, persuasion, and professional presentation to stand out and maximize every opportunity

title: From Campus to Tech Career
description: Our exclusive seminar, 'From Campus to Tech Career', bridged the gap between academic life and the dynamic technology industry. Attendees decoded career roadmaps, learned insider tips for landing dream roles, and gained actionable strategies, clarity, and momentum to confidently launch their futures in tech.

title: Kaggle Prep: From Dataset to Data Analysis
description: Our comprehensive Kaggle Preparation session equipped participants with essential skills, strategies, and insider tips to excel in data science competitions. Attendees explored everything from navigating datasets and building robust models to optimizing submissions and climbing leaderboards, gaining a competitive edge to elevate their data science journey
